optional_improvements: Raise the MISS cue (≈ 8.7 s, peaks about −18 dB) closer to the routine transfer cues while keeping it soft.
Shorten the closing hold (≈ 30–42 s) to about 6–8 s before the fade.
Note in the write-up that cache fills usually set an expiry and that a cache outage is a failure distinct from a miss.
